text: In the Ontario wilderness, a group of friends find [a locket hanging on the remains of a fire tower|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes], and Troy pockets it. Moments later the corpse of Johnny, a serial killer, [rises from the ground|threat|the dead that rise] and roams the woods in search of it. Around their campfire, Ehren tells the legend of how Johnny, a local merchant's son, [fell to his death from the tower in a prank gone wrong|wrong|cruelty and humiliation], unaware that [the locket kept his soul at rest|rules|tied to place or thing].
